name: Tim
source:
Tim is an angel, also a member of the Flaithis imperial guard. Tim is very much a young and bright yet naive person, possessing the innocence of his age. He is very much the "good honor student" type: polite, respectable, and obedient. Romantically, Tim tends to be the submissive-type, but can take on a very caring, motherly love for the person he likes.
